card.name: Small words after a name or title
card.fires_on: Short linking words (as, the, name, was, like, with, entitled) that come right after a person, place or species name and lead into a description, alias or naming statement.

modes.label: Naming phrases
modes.description: Words like as, name, term, entitled that introduce what something is called.
modes.example: Dryococelus australis, commonly known<< as>> the Lord Howe Island stick insect or tree

modes.label: Linking word after a named subject
modes.description: A small word such as was, like or with right after a name, starting a comment about that subject.
modes.example: William S. Burroughs William Burroughs<< was>> born on February 5, 1

modes.label: Article before a role or name
modes.description: The word the after a name and comma, before a role or title.
modes.example: This article was prepared for publication by Elizabeth Imbarlina,<< the>> head of JURIST's student commentary

card.writes: It seems to push the output toward name-like pieces such as ent, boro, bar and S.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words right after a name, where the text is about to say what the thing is called or who it is.
